description: Correlation walked in; make it prove causation. Use when someone claims "X causes Y" from observational data, asks "did the change actually cause the improvement?", "is this confounded?", "what would have happened if we hadn't shipped it?", plans an A/B test, or investigates why an incident/outbreak spread the way it did.
